t: Walt Disney Studios Home Entertainment facts for kids
s: For 37 years, this company was in charge of distributing Disney's movies and shows on physical formats. These included VHS tapes, DVDs, Blu-ray discs, and 4K discs. It started in 1987 as Buena Vista Home Video. In 1997, its legal name changed to Buena Vista Home Entertainment, Inc. The public name changed to Walt Disney Studios Home Entertainment in 2007.
